title: Security and Cryptography: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY TWO QUESTIONS IN SECTION B.

parts.text: Unlike the username and password authentication mechanism that uses "what you know" concept, address-based authentication uses "where you are". Give a detailed description of the address-based authentication mechanism.
